justification: Both surfaces depict a human figure with something on the head and an extended arm, but that is a near-universal correspondence: A is a tiny stick-like schematic figure of a whole body with limbs and an adjacent small motif, while B is a large naturalistic bust in profile with meticulously rendered beard curls, ear, eye, headdress bands and a feathered wing. The manner of depiction differs utterly — pure outline schema versus modelled, densely textured relief — and no specific shared motif or relationship links them.
